items.item_text: BSN and Current California RN license
Three or more years of direct patient care/clinical experience
Two or more years of quality/patient safety experience preferred

Take on a key role within an award-winning health system. Help improve patient experiences as part of a world-class healthcare team. Take your career in an exciting new direction. You can do all this and more at UCLA Health.

You will be responsible for leading and facilitating quality improvement and safety initiatives as part of our commitment to becoming a transformative, high-reliability organization with an uncompromising focus on patient safety and outcomes. This will involve serving as a content expert, performance improvement facilitator, educator, and consultant. You will collaborate with physician and nursing leadership, residents, clinical staff, and administrative/operational staff to help achieve the best outcomes and patient experiences. You will be responsible for data and event monitoring, peer review coordination, education, and facilitation of QI efforts utilizing Lean and other improvement methodologies. You will typically be focused vertically at the department and service line level but may also lead system-wide quality initiatives.
Strong leadership, critical thinking, and decision-making abilities
Commitment to making decisions in the best interest of the patient

the final candidate who accepts an offer of employment will be required to disclose if they have been subject to any final administrative or judicial decisions within the last seven years determining that they committed any misconduct; or have filed an appeal of a finding of substantiated misconduct with a previous employer.
